svg.text: Crosshead plates 10 mm, 50 apart: hinge hole 30.5, axle hole 20.5 120 above

svg.text: Hinge pin 30 x 406; two set collars hold the crosshead central

svg.text: Tie rods 30 x 10 x 470, closed eyes, 420 between 20.5 and 25.5 holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dead end on one plate: stub, arm 45 deep and lug, hole 197 up, 130 aside
